create_llvm_stress_dataset: create an LlvmStressDataset instance with a site_data_base Path for generating random LLVM-IR benchmarks
generate_benchmark_from_seed: generate a Benchmark from a uint32 seed by running llvm-stress and piping output to llvm-as
iterate_benchmark_uris: iterate over all benchmark URIs in the llvm-stress dataset using the benchmark_uris generator method
get_random_benchmark: get a random benchmark from the dataset using a numpy random Generator for reproducible results
parse_benchmark_from_uri: parse a BenchmarkUri and retrieve the corresponding Benchmark by extracting the seed from the URI path
